name: air_nozzle_ejector
title: Air nozzle ejector (primary nozzle and entrainment)
summary: Air ejector: a pressurised primary flow expands through a converging nozzle and entrains a low-pressure secondary flow; mass flows from the total free air delivery and the secondary mass fraction, subsonic orifice-type nozzle equation, momentum/energy mixing at the exit plane, diffuser efficiency correlated with the nozzle diameter and entrainment; returns the suction pressure (suction effect) and the discharge pressure rise.
language_features: CALL WARNING (branch taken at the default point)

verification.summary: The native file was compared with the EES stored solution: 65 common variables, 27 differ at rtol=0.001, max 3.44e-03 on p_dyn_mix_ex_diff; main outputs agree to 1.0e-04 (p_0_su_ej), 6.3e-05 (p_mix_ex_diff) and 3.1e-04 (M_dot_tot). Differences explained by stale stored cells, enthalpy reference and property backend.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (the native file). Provenance audit (README): the stored set is one consistent solved run at FF = 0.1, FAD_tot = 260, T = 30/30 °C, p_1_su_ej = 800000, D_in_ex_noz = 0.02; the stored FF = 0.4 cell and the file's commented FF = 0.4254 block both contradict the mass-flow and epsilon_diff equations (post-solve edits). The import uses the stored-solution input set
verification.notes: compare_solution.py: 65 common variables, 27 differ (rtol=0.001) - 3 stale stored cells (FF 7.50e-01, DELTAp_ex_diff 7.31e-01, epsilon_diff 4.06e-01), 8 enthalpy-reference offsets (2.9e-01, differences agree; the isentropic relations are written with absolute temperatures and do not depend on the reference), 13 property-backend deviations, max 3.44e-03 on p_dyn_mix_ex_diff (CoolProp vs EES air data), 3 velocities C_1_ex_noz/C_mix_ex_noz/C_mix_ex_noz_s at 3.19e-03 (constant-gamma temperature ratio vs EES absolute-enthalpy ratio, +0.49 % on the nozzle kinetic energy); main outputs: p_0_su_ej 1.0e-04, p_mix_ex_diff 6.3e-05, M_dot_tot 3.1e-04, C_1_ex_noz 3.2e-03. The native file is the verified file: it solves in 38 iterations with the shipped coolsolve.conf and .initials, and its 71 variables are equal to those of the former _coolsolve variant (removed). Its CALL WARNING of warning_error are reported at the solution: FF = 0.1 below 0.18 and, through a CoolSolve round-off of the explicit solve (D_in_ex_noz = 0.02 + 1.7e-17), D_in_ex_noz above 0.02. CoolSolve branch fix/library-gaps-2, uncommitted CALL WARNING build.
